lines.latin: Zhongguo Youzheng Chuxu Yinhang (Postal Savings Bank of China)

p1d8e22cf56.notes: Green fascia, angled view from below. The smaller '中国邮政 / CHINA POST' panel to the left and the dim lettering on the upper windows are distractors.

lines.latin: Wangfujing Tianzhu Jiaotang jianjie (Introduction to Wangfujing Catholic Church)

p25faa6d990.notes: Engraved stone interpretive plaque, slightly angled, with leaves on it. Target is the two headings only; the long bilingual history paragraphs below are not labelled. Body text names St. Joseph's / East Cathedral (东堂).

p285530a0b3.notes: Raised metal letters on a curved white fascia. The Chinese is the bank's cursive calligraphic logotype: the characters are certain, but whether 国/银 are drawn in simplified or traditional form (中國銀行) cannot be told at this resolution; simplified is recorded. A small partly cut BOC logo is at the far left edge.

p8fbec9a28f.notes: Illuminated marquee fascia; the name is set as one word with no space. CT monograms flank it. The adidas logo above and the in-window ad text (CT微光粉气垫 ...) are distractors.

pa42fb6820d.notes: Large fascia, angled. Door-side notices (存款保险 DEPOSIT INSURANCE, 军人优先 Soldier first, branch hours board) and the decorated pailou gate at right are distractors.

lines.latin: Lao Beijing Buxie (Old Beijing cloth shoes)

pa721eaed49.notes: Red raised characters above the shoe shop. Distractors: 北京烤鸭 (Beijing roast duck) over the neighbouring shop, a cut-off 中国照... sign at right edge, the vertical 老北京布 banner, and 此门已坏 notice.

pb9d7e8d1b9.notes: Main carved board is written right-to-left in traditional order (appears as 堂仁同 left to right); reading order recorded. Small brass plaque at right reads 北京同仁堂连锁金街药店 / Beijing Tong Ren Tang Chain Drugstore (Gold Street Store). Distractors: yellow 北京同仁堂 BEIJING TONGRENTANG banner above, 天福茗茶 TenFu's TEA sign, history plaques.

pe2209f9c8c.notes: Black fascia with Hi logo, from below. Sub-line '3F 订餐电话：010-858959.. / 010-851109..' has the last phone digits cut off and is not labelled. 天福茗茶 shop sign below and green 天福 sign at right are distractors.

p1f5197279f.notes: Beijing (Wangfujing) watch retailer, angled view from below. 亨得利 is in brush calligraphy (the 彳 of 得 is drawn like a water radical); HENGDELI in a stylised font with a lowercase-looking g. The small 盛时表行 / PRIME TIME logo is above. Distractors: Omega advert 'my little secret' with blurred faces, OMEGA door logo.

lines.latin: Zhōngguó Gōngshāng Yínháng (Industrial and Commercial Bank of China)

p765bafb1bc.notes: Beijing, Wangfujing: ICBC branch fascia with the round 工 logo between ICBC and the Chinese name. Distractors: 'WF CENTRAL / 王府中環' mall blade sign at left (small), door stickers, a brass plaque at right (unreadable).

f01f4d38c-5b5e-4383-a886-40ad500f0c9b.reason: Guangzhou Metro behaviour/fine poster; a warning, no place name

f16eb64cf-b3ba-4cc0-ac8b-7559ab362085.reason: customer-rules notice board at an arcade (顾客须知, no under-18s); house rules, not a place sign apart from a small 'TAITO STATION' header

f66dc5d66-0c3f-4742-94bd-388efe9da83c.notes: Beijing hutong street (Dashilan area), tilted frame: red LED dot-matrix sign over the guesthouse door. Distractors: mirrored red window letters ('...馆 宮...'), green '京...特产超市 / 果脯 烤鸭' sign, '烟酒超市', '北京...' souvenir sign, and a small red house-number plate '12' whose street name is too small to read. A woman in the foreground is incidental.

f6523e8c9-e976-4fc8-9e89-162fe3178524.reason: baskets and a birdcage on a shelf; no sign

lines.text: 美食小吃 特色快餐 石紅雞
lines.latin: měishí xiǎochī, tèsè kuàicān, shí hóng jī (snacks, speciality fast food, ... chicken)

f76feb76a-df21-43aa-9f73-c70941031937.notes: Shanghai street of small shops; the restaurant's red light-box uses traditional characters (飛, 廳, 紅, 雞) in a brush face for the name; keep them as written. The last sub-line phrase is small and reads as 石紅雞 at this resolution. Distractors: '...纺织品公司 / ...呢绒零料专卖店' (simplified) at left, '美食 小吃' window panels, '火锅' and '特色快餐' window signs, a red vertical board at top right.

f117c2d55-5f14-442c-a494-04e9b4bcad5e.reason: airport airline check-in directory board (航空公司办理乘机手续区分布); a list of airlines and counters, not a place-name sign

f14e9bc95-3a13-4b57-b1ff-b6cb9ec7825e.reason: wide airport check-in hall; all signs are small and unreadable

f162dbfab-9d0e-4c9f-8530-ccd44715595c.notes: Beijing, inside the Forbidden City: free-standing dark board in front of a red-pillared hall. A headphone icon precedes 归还处. Distractors: red fire-extinguisher boxes '灭火器箱 / 火警电话119 FIRE ALARM', a small yellow notice on the wall, a tiny line at the board's foot (unreadable).

f4e6feea7-deee-4482-a3f5-e7f587f1cb37.reason: brand-only luxury fascia (LOUIS VUITTON) with no local text; skipped in favour of signs with Chinese text

f5bc22e91-444c-4158-9d95-441b18e9bae8.reason: no-smoking warning sign (禁止吸烟 NO SMOKING); the committee named is the issuer, not a place

lines.latin: al-khalawi ihtikar as-suq al-markazi (cellular monopoly central market)

f6ccbe713-cd67-410e-aeab-8a13272fbfbe.notes: Guangzhou phone mall, multicoloured letters. The C of 'Cell' is drawn like a curled 6. The Cyrillic runs vertically down the right pillar and the Arabic vertically down the left pillar, both small; in the Cyrillic the О of ТЕЛЕФОНОВ is drawn as a phone pictogram, and the first letters of the Arabic are partly cut by the pillar edge. Distractors: Chinese promo banners on the counters (全場…元, 每天7…). Passers-by are incidental.

f8d44a434-fd2d-4cdb-9d34-434630bb173f.reason: Apple Store shown only by its logo; the 'UNION BAR-GRILLE' fascia at right is small and distant

f8e0ea23a-e03b-4582-8dba-643b6fc6d0c2.reason: sale advertising posters (SALE ME, 低至5折) next to a woman whose face is the subject

faad1d964-d571-4950-b2a9-f54d99d430d3.reason: metro passage notice 'Please don't stay here' (请勿在此滞留); an instruction, not a place name

fcfae47ff-3394-4a62-bd00-a9ecf66b038d.notes: Wuhan household-goods shop; target is the small dark-purple address plate on the pillar left of the doorway (road name over the house number, no 号). The plate is small in the frame. Distractors: the red fascia across the top is cut off by the frame (only the lower parts of '…欢迎光临' remain), merchandise labels.
